definitions.explanation: A graded level of skill or quality. As a suffix it marks ranks in proficiency tests and martial arts, or a class within a category.

examples.japanese: {漢字検定|かんじけんてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二級|にきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed level 2 of the Kanji Kentei.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{茶帯|ちゃおび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一級|いっきゅう}だ。
examples.english: In judo, a brown belt is first kyu.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{級|きゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: In this tournament the classes are divided by body weight.

notes:
In ranking systems {級|きゅう} sits below ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ (dan); the numbers count down as skill rises, so {一級|いっきゅう} is the highest kyu, just before reaching dan ranks.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{上級|じょうきゅう}→上級：11298_joukyuu⟧: advanced level
- ⟦{初級|しょきゅう}→初級：11781_shokyuu⟧: beginner level
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧: high-class, luxury
- ⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧: a classmate (same grade)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧: the rank above {級|きゅう} in martial arts and board games
- ⟦{等級|とうきゅう}→等級：28928_toukyuu⟧: a grade or rating, often for quality or price
